title: Minimal Rank-Two Trinomial Kernel, Relation-Space Rigidity, and Sparse Orbit Theorems
normalized_relation: a0 + a1 * (2*pi)^alpha + a2 * (2*pi)^beta = 0 with a0*a1*a2 != 0, alpha, beta in A_R, alpha/beta not in Q

relation_space_dimension_theorem.proof_mechanism: Two independent affine relations force (1, X, Y) into a 1-dimensional subspace over Q_bar, which implies X, Y in Q_bar via Cramer's rule. This forces alpha, beta in S_tau, contradicting dim_Q S_tau <= 1 for Q-independent grades.

exceptional_direction_conditions.proof_mechanism: If X in Q_bar, Y is algebraically determined: Y = (-a0 - a1*X)/a2 in Q_bar. If Y in Q_bar, X = (-a0 - a2*Y)/a1 in Q_bar. If Y/X in Q_bar, X = -a0 / (a1 + a2*(Y/X)) in Q_bar.

real_normalization_status.phase_normalization_mechanism: Since generators X, Y are strictly positive reals, complex conjugation maps any relation to a relation. By dim R_{alpha, beta} = 1, (conj(a0), conj(a1), conj(a2)) = lambda * (a0, a1, a2) with |lambda| = 1. Choosing mu = 1 + lambda (or mu = I if lambda = -1) satisfies conj(mu * a_j) = mu * a_j, yielding real algebraic coefficients in A_R.
real_normalization_status.algorithmic_verification: Verified symbolically and numerically for non-trivial complex coefficient phases.

impossible_configurations: All coefficients strictly positive (a0 > 0, a1 > 0, a2 > 0)
All coefficients strictly negative (a0 < 0, a1 < 0, a2 < 0)

three_positive_affine_orientations.condition: a2 has opposite sign to a0 and a1
a1 has opposite sign to a0 and a2
a0 has opposite sign to a1 and a2

sign_classification.affine_exceptional_relation_locus: A_tau = {(alpha, beta) in A_R^2 : 1, tau^alpha, tau^beta linearly dependent over Q_bar}

orbit_rigidity_status.statement: If f(n) = a0 + a1 * X^n + a2 * Y^n satisfies f(n) = f(n+1) = f(n+2) = 0 for distinct positive bases (1, X, Y), then a0 = a1 = a2 = 0.
orbit_rigidity_status.no_propagation_boundary: f(1) = 0 alone imposes no condition on f(2), f(3), ... TC transport does not produce contradictory grade orbits.

s_unit_theorem_applicability.group_structure: Gamma = <tau^alpha, tau^beta> is free abelian of rank 2 (Gamma \cong Z^2)
primary_citations: Evertse (1984), On sums of S-units and linear recurrences, Invent. Math.
Laurent (1984), Equations diophantiennes exponentielles, Invent. Math.
Evertse, Schlickewei, Schmidt (2002), Linear equations in elements of groups of finite rank, Ann. of Math.

torus_coset_status.proof_mechanism: The line a0 + a1*u + a2*v = 0 with nonzero coefficients contains no translate of an algebraic subtorus u^p * v^q = c of G_m^2, because binomial curves are nonlinear for (p, q) != (0, 0).

canonical_instances.name: CANONICAL_MINIMAL_RANK_TWO_BASE_ONE
canonical_instances.question: Can a0 + a1*(2*pi) + a2*(2*pi)^sqrt(2) = 0 with a0*a1*a2 != 0 in Q_bar?

canonical_instances.name: CANONICAL_MINIMAL_RANK_TWO_RADICAL_PAIR
canonical_instances.question: Can a0 + a1*(2*pi)^sqrt(2) + a2*(2*pi)^sqrt(3) = 0 with a0*a1*a2 != 0 in Q_bar?

exact_next_theorem: Determine whether there exist any Q-independent algebraic grades (alpha, beta) and nonzero real algebraic coefficients (a0, a1, a2) satisfying a0 + a1*(2*pi)^alpha + a2*(2*pi)^beta = 0.
